name: Twin towers
kicker: The Cham pair inside the city
summary: Walk the pair of late-12th-century Cham towers inside the city. The fee is 20,000 đồng. Tháp Bánh Ít, about 20 km away, is a different site.
timeNeeded: 120 minutes on the portal. That is the printed field.
getThere: Inside the city. Minutes from the beach are check on arrival.
heroCaption: Both towers, tops and bases, in daylight
gettingThere: The header says Phường Quy Nhơn. The prose says phường Đống Đa. The towers are inside the city. Minutes from the beach are check on arrival. A science-complex page lists them 8.45 km from that complex, which is not a measured ride from the sand.
Tháp Bánh Ít is about 20 km away in Tuy Phước. Do not send this visit there.

legs.heading: From the city beach
legs.body: A ride inside the city. The portal does not print the minutes. Check on arrival.

closed: No weekly closing day is printed.
admissionNote: 20,000 đồng on the portal. The field is printed as 20,000–20,000. A child price is not printed.
